pageSubtitle: Connect your own outbound mailboxes with tenant-isolated credential encryption or Google / Microsoft 365 authorization, and verify domain deliverability records.
adminOnlyNotice: Only workspace administrators can add mailboxes, store encrypted credentials, connect authorization, or verify domain DNS.
securityBannerDesc: Passwords and authorization tokens are encrypted with a workspace-scoped key before storage, never echoed back in plaintext, and polled in strict per-tenant isolation.

credSecurityHint: Stored secrets are never echoed back. Private hosts and non-standard mail ports are blocked automatically.
